summary: Between the August 26 hearing draft and the September 9 recommendation, the server-room exception changed from placing such uses inside the Data Storage category as accessory to placing them outside the category entirely.
text: August 26: 'are defined by their primary use, to which Data Storage is accessory.' September 9: 'are defined by their primary use, not as Data Storage.'

source.citation: Exhibit A as published Aug 26 2026 and Sept 9 2026

notes: A use outside the category is not counted against a limitation on the category
confidence_note: No inference drawn about why the text changed. Whether a given project falls inside or outside the category is an application question decided by the City.
